type DeepPartial<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: DeepPartial<T[K]> };
type Flatten<T> = T extends (infer U)[] ? Flatten<U> : T;
type TupleOf<N extends number, A extends unknown[] = []> = A["length"] extends N ? A : TupleOf<N, [...A, unknown]>;
type Reverse<S extends string> = S extends `${infer H}${infer R}` ? `${Reverse<R>}${H}` : "";
const partial: DeepPartial<{a: {b: number}}> = {a: {}};
const flattened: Flatten<number[][][]> = 3;
const tuple: TupleOf<3> = [1, "two", true];
const reversed: Reverse<"abc"> = "cba";
console.log(partial, flattened, tuple, reversed);
